file_spec.value: Photos must be uploaded in jpeg, tiff or png format; applicant must not upload the photo used in their passport. Official brochure text: "Ensure that you have in place a clear passport style photograph [jpeg, tiff or png]. Do not upload the photo from your passport."

cross_verification.note_en: Two official Zambia Department of Immigration documents were read in full: the 32-page 'Guide on Immigration Permits & Visas' PDF and the 'What is an e-Visa?' brochure PDF (both hosted at zambiaimmigration.gov.zm), plus the live 'Visa Requirements by Purpose of Visit' page and the eservices.zambiaimmigration.gov.zm portal landing page. All sources consistently require only a 'passport sized photo' for every visa category (Business, Diplomatic, Official, Religious, School, Tourist, Transit, Visitor) — none states an exact cm/mm dimension, background color, or head-height figure anywhere in the documents. The DB's existing values (3.5 x 4.5cm / white / 3.2-3.6cm) could therefore neither be confirmed nor contradicted by any official Zambian government source found in this research pass, so they are left unverified rather than asserted or flagged as a conflict.
cross_verification.visa_validity_distinction: The e-Visa document itself (not the photo) is stated to be valid for 90 days from date of first issuance (multiple entry visas for US nationals: 3 years). This is the VISA's validity, not a photo-recency requirement, so it was not entered under the 'validity' (photo validity) field.
